capabilities: Merge note blocks quoting the same highlight, using the quoted text as identity
Preserve comments written under quotes, keeping both when copies differ
Fold appended highlight sections back into the main highlights section
Back up notes to a backups/ folder before rewriting, pruned to the most recent 30
Run automatically after a clip, sweep all clippings on startup, or on a manual command
extras: Not yet in the community catalog; installed by copying files or via BRAT. Includes a matching Web Clipper create+append template pair with Japanese variants, and Japanese settings guidance.
intentEvidence: merges duplicate highlights appended by the official Obsidian Web Clipper
motivation: The clipper intentionally has no knowledge of the vault and cannot append only new highlights (obsidian-clipper#180), so the author built a vault-side merge.
problem: The Web Clipper appends all highlights on a page at every clip, so reading an article in multiple sittings duplicates quotes already saved in the note.

relations.evidence: merges duplicate highlights appended by the official Obsidian Web Clipper

summary: Merges duplicate highlights that Obsidian Web Clipper appends when re-clipping a page, while preserving comments written under each quote.
